description: ticket guard for subagents: in a session where /kensei-toolkit:ticket is active, subagents may not commit, push or write to the tracker. The sh prefix exits at once for main-session calls, unmarked sessions or a missing guard.py.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"agent_id"'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; g="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/ticket/guard.py"; [ -f "$g" ] || exit 0; s=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([A-Za-z0-9_-]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1); [ -n "$s" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.claude/task-runs/.guard/$s" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | python3 "$g" --subagent
